analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Position vs SMA100 ($0.18)/SMA200 ($0.22): Mixed medium to long-term trend with price above SMA100 but below SMA200.
· 52-week position (9.3%) + Current price level is a recovery zone from the 52-week low ($0.14).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (74.3→62.0) + Cooling from overbought territory + Downward momentum confirmed.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0039→0.0018) + Improvement diagnosed + Trend reversal signal still weak.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $0.20) + Bandwidth at 38.00% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($0.17) + Based on Pivot S1 level.
· Swing resistance level ($0.26) + Based on 20-day high level; potential for upward trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) + Trend direction unconfirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.61) + Low conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 confirmed with accompanying volume increase.
